stem:
Gwen spent $12.50 to purchase 5 bracelets. Each bracelet cost the same amount.

Which graph has a slope that best represents this rate?

options.label: D
options.text: (Graph with points from (1,0.5) to (7,3.5) increasing gradually)

visual_elements: Graph A: Cost $y$ vs Number Purchased $x$, points visible at (1,5) and (2,10)
Graph B: Cost $y$ vs Number Purchased $x$, single point visible at (1, 12.5)
Graph C: Cost $y$ vs Number Purchased $x$, points visible at (1,2.5), (2,5), (4,10), (5,12.5)
Graph D: Cost $y$ vs Number Purchased $x$, points visible gradually increasing from (1,0.5) to (7,3.5)
notes: The problem asks which graph's slope best matches the unit rate of $12.50/5 = 2.5 dollars per bracelet.
